P01.rationale: A large portrait of the client (Tobias Frese) occupies roughly half the left column, making it a dominant human anchor, though it is a video-still rather than a clean portrait.

P05.rationale: The client portrait is clearly framed and named beneath it ('Frese Recruiting / Tobias Frese'), occupying a meaningful portion of the left column, though it is a video screenshot rather than a polished headshot.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus beyond a single inline pull-quote; no structured social-proof block is present.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears before the testimonial text, but there are no giant ghost numerals or other oversized decorative typographic elements.

P11.rationale: A clear before/after data comparison ('bis zu 24 Std → rund 2 Min') with labelled metrics (200.000€+, 99%) is present, though it is typographic rather than a chart or graph.

P12.rationale: The left column is well-filled with structured sections and the portrait, but the right column has significant open space between the metrics, making the overall density moderate rather than magazine-dense.

P13.rationale: A subtle warm off-white/cream background texture is used throughout, providing a mild atmospheric quality, but it is very understated and close to flat.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo has a dark background that naturally provides contrast, and no text is overlaid directly on the image, so readability is maintained without a formal scrim.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a real video-still of the named client rather than a generic stock photo, lending some specificity, though the image quality and context are somewhat ambiguous.

N08.rationale: The right column has large empty regions between the metric statements and the testimonial block, creating noticeable dead whitespace that reduces overall density.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over a busy photo without a scrim; the image and text areas are cleanly separated into distinct zones.
